o: Welcome to another season of adventures with Zed, Addison, and the rest of the Seabrook crew - plus a mischievous new student who’s bound to make this senior redo even wilder.

v.n: ZOMBIES: The Re-Animated Series Season 2 Official Trailer!…

eps.o: Addison and friends try to solve the mystery of Seabrook Senior Searchnanigans Day.
Zed fixes up his basement to be the ultimate hangout spot, but Bonzo's art project may ruin it.
Bucky's new magical face cream accidentally turns his friends into babies.
Addison films a documentary about Wynter, who has become a football hero due to her game-winning catch.
Dae needs to form a coven to complete her "Trials of Seven" and become an adult witch.
Addison and Wyatt try to fix their awkward friendship before it destroys their relationships.
Zed and Bucky bond over their love of Prawx body spray and try to make their own.
The kids try to keep Addison away from game night, before she becomes an over-competitive monster.
Zoey does a project about Lost and Found detectives and becomes a rookie recruit.
Willa fails an improv class, so she recruits Demón to help her.
Willa is a superstar scorer in Luma Ball, but her spotlight hogging frustrates her teammate Addison.
Addison enlists her clone to go see a Pumpkinface horror movie with Bree.
Fiona, a fairy with a mischievous side, shows up for her first day at Seabrook High.
Zed is to be crowned King of the Shrimp Boil, but a butterfly swarm threatens his coronation.
For Halloween, Dae takes her aunt's place telling spooky stories to the Witches of the Cauldron. But when the monsters from her stories come to life, can Dae somehow save Seabrook?
Afraid she's being labeled "a goofball," Wynter takes on a more serious identity.
Usually "too cool" for toys, Fiona falls in love with Bun-Kins and magically brings them to life.
When Skullberries attack the town, can Bree's A.M. TV show still make her viewers smile?

eps.t: The Z-O-M-B-I-E-S: The Re-Animated Series Karaoke Singalong Spectacular
eps.o: Due to a cursed karaoke machine, Zed, Addison and friends must sing for three demon judges.
